Hi everyone! [b]Oxy949[/b] here with some good news. Our team prepared new big update for you!

[b]• Added sounds for mobs[/b]
[b]• Added ammo for guns[/b]
[b]• Removed falling items damage[/b]
[b]• Reordered main menu elements[/b]
[b]• Fixed lots of bugs[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Ladies and gentlemen, we have fixed some bugs:

[b]• Improved inventory. Now there is a tooltip when you hover over the object[/b]
[b]• Fixed time lines on some endings (cases when the game crashes)[/b]
[b]• Fixed global variables to be considered in the second chapter[/b]
[b]• Added warning message, when you start a new game without training[/b]
[b]• Fixed some spelling mistakes[/b]

If you find bugs, please let us know in a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/788480/discussions/1/]special section[/url] of the Steam community 
or on the [url=https://discord.gg/fxQPAGp]discord server[/url]

Enjoy the game!
